jobs.description:
What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

Join an international company operating (logistics sector), based in Nivelles, as a Junior Supply Chain Graduate and gain exposure to planning, inventory management, logistics coordination, and continuous improvement projects. This is an opportunity for a recent graduate to develop key supply chain skills, work with experienced professionals, and build a long-term career in an international environment.

Informations sur l'entreprise

 Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Renowned for its collaborative culture, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to talent development, the company offers an excellent environment for young professionals looking to launch their career in Supply Chain.

To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

 

Missions

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
• Comfortable working with data and supply chain KPIs
• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders
• Team player with a positive and hands-on attitude

Software Engineer Vacancy
 

Are you passionate about building innovative digital solutions? Devatwork is looking for a talented Fullstack Engineer to join our dynamic team. If you think you are a match, we want to hear from you!
 

What You'll Do:
 

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications
 

● Develop both front-end and back-end solutions
 

● Communicate with clients to understand their pain points and offer solutions
 

● Ensure optimal performance, security, and responsiveness across all platforms
 

● Work with cloud services and databases
 

● Be a leader in your field, and help others grow with you
 

What We're Looking For:
 

● Strong proficiency in Full Stack Development
 

● Have at least 2 years of professional experience
 

● Experience with React, Vue.js, Angular, or similar front-end frameworks
 

● Solid knowledge of Node.js, Django, Laravel, or other back-end technologies
 

● Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases
 

● Knowledge of version control systems (git or others)

 

● Be able to work on multiple projects simultaneously

 

● Ability to master technologies/tools on request

 

● Understanding of Enterprise Level Architectures

 

● English speaking, Dutch or French are strong assets

 

● Be open to be working in Ghent, Belgium 4 days a week in the office

 

Preferred Skills:
 

● Experience leading small teams

 

● Understanding of DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines is a plus

 

● Knowledge of CMS Solutions (Drupal, WordPress and others)

Would you like to join an international company on a human scale in Brussels and gain valuable professional experience? We are looking for a versatile Travel & Customer Care Assistant to support the DiscoverEU team in delivering smooth travel coordination and high-quality participant support. Key Responsibilities Travel & Customer Care
 
 
 
• Respond promptly to participant enquiries via email and chat, ensuring agreed service levels are met 
 
• Coordinate travel logistics, including booking support, document verification, and expense/invoice tracking 
 
• Identify and escalate complex cases to the appropriate team members when required 
 
• Manage special travel situations (e.g. accessibility needs, lost tickets, rebookings) and maintain accurate records 
 
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, data protection rules, and financial guidelines 
 
• Support administrative tasks and team coordination as needed 
 
• Troubleshoot participant documentation issues and follow escalation processes 
 

 Admin, IT & Tools
 
 
 
• Use internal platforms and helpdesk tools to efficiently assist participants 
 
• Work with databases, IT systems, and standard office tools 
 
• Ensure all data handling complies with GDPR and internal IT security protocols 
 
• Promote sustainability principles as part of EMAS commitments 

 
 
•   
 
• Available between June and August (with extension until September–October for German and/or Polish speakers) 
 
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken) 
 
• Good written skills in German, Dutch, and/or Polish (German and Polish are strong assets) 
 
• Strong customer service mindset and professional communication skills 
 
• Well-organised, able to manage priorities and meet deadlines 
 
• Detail-oriented, with a focus on quality, accuracy, and consistency 
 
•

At Michael Page, you'll do much more than recruit. You'll act as a partner for both clients and candidates, helping businesses grow while changing careers and lives. This role offers an exciting combination of talent acquisition, consulting, and business development.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Omschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.

As an Alarm Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, programming, and maintenance of security systems. You will work on a variety of projects, ranging from private residences to large-scale commercial installations.

jobs.occupation: Electromechanical Technician - motors & machinery | Brucargo | ENG
jobs.description:
For a technical maintenance company operating at the airport, we are looking for a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery. As a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on a wide range of Ground Support Equipment (GSE), including pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, and other motorized vehicles. You will ensure that all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with current standards.

Your responsibilities include:

 

 
•  
 Performing maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on GSE equipment (pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, etc.). 

 
• Troubleshooting and resolving faults in electrical and electronic assemblies. 
 
• Installing, testing, and commissioning electrical systems according to current safety standards and regulations. 
 

 
• Documenting maintenance and repair activities and contributing to technical reports. 
 
•  
Providing on-the-job training to other mechanics on troubleshooting and complex electrical systems. 

 
• Ensuring compliance with legal regulations, safety standards, and quality assurance guidelines. 
 
•  
Keeping tools, equipment, and test devices in good working condition through routine checks and cleaning. 

 
• Preparing equipment for handover to customers or deployment on airport sites. 
 

 
• Coordinating with mechanical, electrical, and workshop technicians to ensure efficient and safe execution of repair and maintenance tasks. 

 
• Completed vocational training as an industrial electrician, electronics technician for industrial engineering, mechatronics technician, or a comparable qualification. 
 
• Extensive experience in the maintenance and repair of electrical systems, ideally in aviation or a related technical field. 
 
• Experience with high voltage equipment, preferably with certification. 
 
• Extensive knowledge of control technology and proficiency in reading circuit diagrams. 
 
• Excellent communication skills to report issues and collaborate with other workshop personnel. 
 
• Good command of local language as well as English language, both spoken and written. 
 
• Class B driving license, additional driving permits are an advantage. 
 
• Possess or are eligible to obtain an airport security pass and an airport driving permit.

• As a Client Advisor in our NATO office, you will act as the first point of contact for clients within your assigned client segment (expats). 

• You will be responsible for the end-to-end management and accurate follow-up of your non-life insurance portfolio. 

• You will advise clients, prepare quotations, contact clients, discuss the proposed insurance solutions, and issue new insurance policies. 

• You will process all relevant data and contracts in our BRIO management system. 

• You will communicate with both insurers and clients on a daily basis via email and telephone. 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in insurance or an equivalent qualification. 

• You have several years of experience in the insurance sector. 

• You have a solid understanding of non-life insurance products and enjoy advising clients within your assigned client segment (expats). 

• You are sociable and communicate confidently with clients in person, by phone and via email. 

• You are customer-focused and combine this with a commercial mindset. You recognize opportunities and proactively pursue them. 

• You have professional communication skills in English and/or French and/or Dutch. 

• You are accurate, organized, and meticulous in your administrative work, ensuring all information is correctly recorded in our BRIO management system. 

• You are proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) and are comfortable working with BRIO. 

• You are willing to work from our NATO office and understand that access to the premises is subject to NATO’s strict security and registration procedures. You are comfortable complying with these requirements. 

• You are willing to work from the NATO office every weekday.

As a Team Leader – Production, you play a key role in our manufacturing operations. You are responsible for coordinating the daily production activities while leading and supporting your team. By combining a people-oriented leadership style with a focus on quality, safety, and continuous improvement, you help achieve production targets and maintain the highest quality standards.

Your Responsibilities:

• Lead, coach, and motivate operators on the production line.
• Foster a positive, respectful, and collaborative team environment.
• Monitor and continuously improve quality, safety, and workplace organisation.
• Oversee the daily production schedule and ensure the production line operates efficiently.
• Manage stock levels and ensure the correct use of materials.
• Work with production software and ERP systems, including Iris and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• Perform basic administrative tasks and prepare production reports.
• Communicate effectively in either Dutch or English with colleagues and stakeholders.

Are You the Team Leader We're Looking For?

• You have strong leadership and coaching skills and know how to inspire a team.
• You communicate confidently, clearly, and with a positive attitude.
• You are comfortable working with computer systems and quickly adapt to new software.
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality, safety, and efficiency.
• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.
• Experience in a manufacturing or production environment is an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

• Patient reception: Welcome and assist patients upon arrival
• Phone management: Handle incoming calls, patient inquiries, and appointment requests
• Schedule coordination: Organise and update practitioners' schedules (appointments, emergencies, reminders via email/SMS)
• Administrative communication: Communicate with patients, insurance funds, laboratories, and suppliers
• Document handling: Process patient records, forms, and insurance documentation accurately
• Practice support: Assist the team with daily operational tasks to ensure smooth workflow 
• Rigorous, motivated, friendly, and dynamic
• Strong organisational and administrative skills
• Able to work autonomously and take initiative
• Excellent command of English (required); Dutch is highly desirable
• Knowledge of Arabic or Romanian is an asset
• Previous experience in a medical or dental environment is desirable
• Good computer skills (agenda software, email, basic administration) 
Contract Details

• Initial contract: full-time (35h/week)
• Working hours: Monday to Friday between 10:00 and 17:30
